title: White Revolution
summary: A program of modernization and reform carried out in Iran by Mohammad Reza Shah Pahlavi from 1963 until 1979. It redistributed land, created literacy and health corps, and extended voting rights to women. It weakened landowners and clerical power, and benefits were uneven. Rapid urbanization followed, and the program ended with the 1979 Islamic revolution.
